name: capitalflow-mvp
description: PWA + Android personal finance tracker with notification/email ingestion and Whop subscriptions.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @capitalflow/core && npm run build -w @capitalflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @capitalflow/core && npm run test:edge-parser && npm run test:private-boundary
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @capitalflow/core && npm run typecheck -w @capitalflow/web
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @capitalflow/core && npm run clean -w @capitalflow/web
